blocks.text: Political drama film “EDJOP” is set to hold its international premiere at the 39th Tokyo International Film Festival, where it will compete in the Asian Future section. The Elijah Canlas-led movie joins a lineup that includes Iran’s “I’m Nothing Special Really” and “Silver,” Indonesia’s “Jani Be Good” Japan’s “Miracle Summer” and “Saravah,” South Korea’s “On the Heights,” India’s “The Paper Flower,” Kazakhstan’s “Shyrmauyq,” and Switzerland-Turkey co-production “Serife Tavsan.” “EDJOP” will have its screenings at the film fest on Oct. 27 and 29.
